about_the_game:
Scary Stories is a horror game that will center around a long-running arc over several episodes. Each episode will spotlight a certain character that you will come to love, each with their own backstories.

Survive your first night in the apartment.

Scary Stories - Apartment

In this story, you play as Jenny.

You just moved in to a new apartment last week and have few acquaintances.
One night, during a storm, a series of events unfold that you must successfully navigate.

Will you make the right choices, or are you destined for something else?

What you will experience

  • A progressive story, with several decisions that can be made.

  • A hand-crafted immersive and atmospheric environment.

  • Stylized aesthetic with optional filters.

  • Secrets and things to explore and discover.

  • Checkpoints for those that don't survive.

The apartment episode is a shorter episode, expected to last anywhere between 30 to 40 minutes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Integrated graphics not officially supported.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Scary Stories is a stylized horror experience told through multiple episodes. Each chapter immerses you in the life of a new character, blending personal backstories with chilling encounters that react to your decisions.
